mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as risk appetite increases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
